statement.text:
import Mathlib
import Nodes.«erdos-1094--h3--h3--h1--h1--h1--h1».Context

open scoped Nat

/-! Hole `h_wi` of a merged partial proof, as a node (D-12 #5, D-29).
Statement generated by the gate from the assembly; immutable (D-3). -/

theorem erdos_1094__h3__h3__h1__h1__h1__h1 : ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ),
  (∀ (n : ℕ), (0 : ℝ) ≤ f n) →
    (∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s) →
      (∃ (G : ℂ → ℂ),
          ContinuousOn G {s : ℂ | (1 : ℝ) ≤ s.re} ∧
            ∀ (s : ℂ), (1 : ℝ) < s.re → G s = LSeries (fun (n : ℕ) => (↑(f n) : ℂ)) s - (↑A : ℂ) / (s - (1 : ℂ))) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f n) / (↑N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds A) := by
  sorry

witness.text:
import Mathlib
open scoped Nat

theorem witness : ∃ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℝ), (∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) ∧
    (∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeriesSummable (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s) ∧
    (∃ G : ℂ → ℂ, ContinuousOn G {s | 1 ≤ s.re} ∧
      ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → G s = LSeries (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) s - A / (s - 1)) :=
  ⟨fun _ => 0, 0, fun _ => le_rfl, fun s _ => by simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero]; exact LSeriesSummable_zero,
    ⟨fun _ => 0, continuousOn_const, fun s _ => by simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_div, sub_zero]; exact (congrFun LSeries_zero s).symm⟩⟩
